headline: Flamengo one draw from the Brasileirao title as Palmeiras fans hand back tickets
facts: Flamengo lead Palmeiras by six points with three rounds left and hold the first tiebreaker, so a draw in the Saturday 21 November clash at Nubank Parque would be enough for the title.
Flamengo beat Athletico-PR 2-1 while Palmeiras lost 2-1 to Cruzeiro, and Abel Ferreira effectively conceded the league afterwards.
Some Palmeiras fans cancelled their tickets for the match and ESPN reports some starters may be rested ahead of the Libertadores and Copa do Brasil finals.
background: Flamengo beat Palmeiras 1-0 in the 2025 Copa Libertadores final for their fourth continental title, per ESPN.
footage_terms: Abel Ferreira press conference Flamengo title

headline: Gremio and Internacional both stuck in the relegation zone with three rounds left
facts: ESPN's Opta-based odds give Gremio about a 73% and Internacional about a 59% chance of going down, with Gremio on 38 points after a 0-0 home draw with Bahia.
Chapecoense are already relegated and Remo are about 99.98% likely to follow.
Corinthians eased their own danger with a 4-0 win over Botafogo and now carry roughly an 19% relegation chance.
background: Gremio and Internacional are the two big Porto Alegre clubs whose derby is the Gre-Nal; ESPN's headline calls them the 'GreNal duo'.
footage_terms: Vasco Internacional Sao Januario melhores momentos

headline: Libertadores final set: Estudiantes against Palmeiras in Montevideo on 28 November
facts: Palmeiras president Leila Pereira said the club's full focus is the Libertadores and Copa do Brasil, summing it up as 'nothing else matters'.
The Libertadores final against Estudiantes is on 28 November at the Centenario in Montevideo.
Palmeiras reached the final by beating Fluminense 5-3 on penalties after the semifinal finished level on aggregate.
background: Brazilian clubs have won the last seven Libertadores titles; the last non-Brazilian winner was River Plate in the all-Argentine 2018 final.

headline: Estudiantes knock Flamengo out of the Libertadores on penalties after two 0-0 draws
facts: The second leg at the Maracana ended 0-0 and Estudiantes won the shootout 3-2, after a goalless first leg in La Plata on 15 October.
Flamengo were the defending Libertadores champions.
The result kept alive Estudiantes' bid for a first continental title since 2009.
background: Estudiantes won three straight Libertadores titles from 1968 to 1970 and again in 2009; last year Flamengo beat them in a quarterfinal shootout.

headline: Neymar banned two games for covering his mouth under the 'Vinicius Junior rule'
facts: Brazil's sports tribunal gave Neymar a two-match ban after he was sent off in Santos' 1-0 win over Bahia for covering his mouth while arguing with Bahia midfielder Rodrigo Nestor.
Neymar admitted the gesture was wrong but denied insulting Nestor, while Bahia condemned what it called verbal abuse.
The ban was on top of an accumulated-yellow-card suspension and could still be appealed.
background: Neymar is Brazil's all-time top scorer with 80 goals in 130 games and retired from international football after the 2026 World Cup.
footage_terms: Neymar red card covering mouth Santos Bahia

headline: Neymar finishes 10th in a poker tournament and wins 24,000 dollars
facts: Neymar finished 10th in an invitation-only 50K Super High Roller event that had 152 entries and a roughly 1.2 million dollar prize pool.
He paid a 15,000 dollar buy-in, played for more than eight hours and was knocked out by 2024 world poker champion Pedro Neves.
Two nights earlier he finished 12th in a separate event with a 4,000 dollar buy-in.
background: Neymar plays poker regularly and finished 29th in the Brazilian Series of Poker last year, per ESPN.

headline: Corinthians hire Clarence Seedorf after seven straight league defeats
facts: Corinthians named Seedorf head coach on a contract running to the end of 2027, replacing Fernando Diniz who was fired after seven consecutive league losses.
The club was 16th of 20, one place above the relegation zone, at the time.
Seedorf last coached Cameroon more than seven years ago and none of his three previous club spells lasted longer than six months.
background: Seedorf is the only player to win the European Cup or Champions League with three different clubs: Ajax, Real Madrid and AC Milan.

headline: Botafogo keep Tite after a 4-0 loss but call the Sao Paulo game a final
facts: After the 4-0 home defeat to Corinthians on 18 November the board decided not to sack Tite, though some inside the club reportedly wanted a change.
Leadership, the SAF board, staff and players met at the training ground on 19 November and demanded a 'sense of urgency'.
The home game against Sao Paulo on 23 November is being treated as a final for staying in Serie A and chasing a continental place.
background: Tite is a former Brazil national team coach who now leads Botafogo.

headline: Thiago Silva, 42, undecided on retirement as Fluminense clinch a Libertadores place
facts: Interim coach Marcao joined the fans' campaign for Thiago Silva to stay, joking that the 42-year-old could play about three more years.
Silva's contract runs to the end of December 2026 and he has not announced a decision.
A 1-0 win away at Sao Paulo secured Fluminense a Libertadores place; they are fourth with 60 points.
background: ESPN reported last year that Thiago Silva, then 41, was aiming for a place in Brazil's World Cup squad.

headline: Vasco sign Carlos Vinicius on a pre-contract and annoy Gremio
facts: Striker Carlos Vinicius signed a pre-contract with Vasco in early November and is expected to join in January on a two-year deal with an option for a third year.
Gremio say their finances blocked a renewal, and its board felt the player's side was not transparent about the pre-contract.
Gremio are in the relegation zone on 38 points yet still have a Copa do Brasil final against Palmeiras on 6 December in Brasilia.
background: Renato Portaluppi coaches Gremio, and ESPN reports he will keep playing Carlos Vinicius despite the off-field row.

headline: Chapecoense crash survivor Alan Ruschel retires after helping Juventude win promotion
facts: Ruschel, a 37-year-old left-back, came on in the 74th minute of Juventude's 2-0 home win over Botafogo that secured direct promotion to Serie A.
He announced his retirement afterwards in an Instagram post.
He returned to his boyhood club Juventude in 2023.
background: Ruschel was one of six survivors of the 2016 Chapecoense plane crash in Colombia that killed 71 people, including 19 players.

headline: Brazilian winger Sergio Barboza becomes first outfield player to play in all six confederations
facts: The 33-year-old reached Tahiti on 21 September with no club and was helped by about 300 followers paying 6 dollars a month who voted on decisions in a WhatsApp group.
He scored twice and set up another in a 5-1 win on his Tahiti debut and ended his stint with four goals and four assists in five games, unpaid apart from accommodation.
A cyclone doubled his return flight to about 3,000 dollars and he plans to go back to Africa to score and assist there.
background: Barboza was a Flamengo youth player who left in 2011 and has since played in Costa Rica, Laos, Cambodia, India, Nepal, Malta, Angola and the US.

headline: Ronaldinho, 46, comes out of retirement for Ravenna and lasts 45 minutes
facts: Ronaldinho played 45 minutes for Serie C side Ravenna against Forli and did not score, so he stayed on 299 career goals.
He nearly set up a goal with a corner that Giulio Donati headed, but it was saved.
Ravenna's president said Ronaldinho did not want to leave the pitch and hinted at another appearance.
background: Ronaldinho won the 2002 World Cup with Brazil and was FIFA World Player of the Year twice in a row; his previous match was for Fluminense in September 2015.

headline: Brazil lose 3-2 to Japan as Ancelotti and captain Raphinha are sent off
facts: Japan beat Brazil 3-2 in a friendly in Singapore with a 91st-minute winner.
Ancelotti and captain Raphinha were both sent off late on after protesting that goal.
Ancelotti had to serve a one-match touchline ban against Singapore and Bruno Guimaraes took the armband.
background: Brazil went out of the 2026 World Cup in the round of 16 against Norway, and Ancelotti has coached the national team since 2025.

headline: Romario demands Brazil sack Ancelotti and Ancelotti shrugs it off
facts: Before the Singapore friendly, Romario posted on Instagram criticising Ancelotti's work and urging the CBF president to fire him.
Ancelotti answered that Romario has the right to speak as much as he wants, and said he likes the direction but must do more.
Under Ancelotti Brazil lost the World Cup round of 16 to Norway and since then have won two and lost one.
background: Romario is a 1994 World Cup winner for Brazil.

headline: Vinicius Junior scores a 21-minute hat-trick as Brazil beat Singapore 7-0
facts: Vinicius scored three times in the first 21 minutes of the 7-0 friendly win, his first international hat-trick, after both goals in the 3-2 loss to Japan.
Endrick, Estevao and Rayan also scored and Singapore's Raoul Suhaimi added an own goal.
Vinicius has just one goal in 12 appearances for Real Madrid this season and looked upset at being substituted early in the second half.
background: Vinicius now has 19 goals in 59 appearances for Brazil.

headline: Vinicius admits poor preparation and Mourinho tells him to win his place back
facts: Vinicius said he trained less than usual after the World Cup, and Mourinho replied that blaming preseason preparation was a mistake and that Vinicius must win his place back.
New signing Yan Diomande has taken his starting spot and Vinicius has one goal in eight LaLiga appearances this season.
He returns from a four-game ban, handed after a red card for pulling Villarreal's Nathan Saliba's hair, for the Celta Vigo match on 21 November.
background: Vinicius was linked with Arsenal in the summer but signed a long-term Real Madrid deal that runs until 2032.

headline: Estevao struggles for minutes at Chelsea under Xabi Alonso
facts: Estevao has started only once in 10 Premier League games this season, a 2-0 home win over Manchester United in late October.
Xabi Alonso prefers a 3-4-3 that does not suit him, and Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers occupy his favoured attacking spots.
Alonso says there are no plans to move him, while with Brazil under Ancelotti Estevao has five goals and four starts in five post-World Cup games.
background: Estevao left Palmeiras after a wonder goal against Chelsea at the Club World Cup and picked Chelsea over Real Madrid and Barcelona.

headline: Raphinha's comments about managing Brazil minutes go down badly at home
facts: Raphinha, 29, said he wants to play for Brazil as much as possible as long as his body allows, after talking with Ancelotti about managing his minutes.
The comments were poorly received in Brazil and he said they were misinterpreted and about fitness.
He brought forward ear-cyst surgery so he could join Brazil's two November friendlies and was set to captain the side against Japan.
background: Raphinha has 19 goals in 14 appearances for Barcelona this season, per ESPN.

headline: Barcelona want Liverpool to make Ronald Araujo's loan permanent for 55 million euros
facts: Deco said Barcelona would welcome Liverpool using a 55 million euro option to turn Araujo's loan into a permanent deal and may be flexible on timing and fee.
The 27-year-old Uruguayan has two goals in 15 appearances for Liverpool since joining in the summer.
Deco denied pushing out left-back Alejandro Balde, who has five appearances for 124 minutes this season.
background: Araujo is a Uruguayan defender who spent years at Barcelona before the summer loan to Liverpool.

headline: Mac Allister's father says Liverpool contract talks have not started
facts: His father Carlos said no renewal talks have begun, with about 20 months left on the deal, and an update could come before year-end.
He dismissed any near-term return to Argentine club football, saying the player's career is still in Europe.
Mac Allister has started every Premier League game this season, scoring one league goal and three Champions League goals.
background: Mac Allister joined Liverpool from Brighton in 2023 and won the 2024-25 Premier League title.
footage_terms: Mac Allister Liverpool Champions League gol

headline: Argentina lose 2-1 to Uruguay in their first match since Messi retired
facts: Uruguay won 2-1 at La Bombonera, with an own goal from Leonardo Balerdi, a Maxi Araujo goal and a Julian Alvarez reply for Argentina.
The stadium was not sold out and Scaloni left the No. 10 shirt unassigned.
Scaloni said Argentina must rebuild without Messi, while Diego Forlan was in charge of Uruguay as their new coach.
background: Argentina were the 2026 World Cup runners-up, beaten 1-0 by Spain in the final in New Jersey.

headline: Argentina thrash Costa Rica 7-0 in a statement win without Messi
facts: Nico Paz, Julian Alvarez and Franco Mastantuono each scored twice in Cordoba and Alexis Mac Allister added one.
Emiliano Martinez captained the side and reached 47 clean sheets for Argentina, matching Sergio Romero's record.
Martinez said the team wants fans to fall in love with it all over again after the previous Friday's loss to Uruguay.
background: Argentina made five changes from the side that lost 2-1 to Uruguay four days earlier.
footage_terms: Nico Paz gol Argentina Costa Rica

headline: Masked Emi Martinez returns for Argentina after jaw surgery
facts: Martinez hurt his jaw on 16 October in a collision with Everton defender Jarrad Branthwaite and then had surgery.
He returned to training in a protective mask about two weeks later, and Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso left him out of the 8 November loss to Sunderland as too risky.
Scaloni confirmed he would replace Geronimo Rulli for the Costa Rica match.
background: Martinez plays for Chelsea under Xabi Alonso and is Argentina's first-choice goalkeeper; the Costa Rica match was his return after about a month out.

headline: Scaloni signs new Argentina deal through the 2030 World Cup
facts: AFA president Claudio Tapia confirmed the 2027-2030 renewal for Scaloni and his staff, making him the first coach to lead Argentina at three World Cups.
In 107 matches Argentina under Scaloni have 79 wins, 18 draws and 10 losses.
Scaloni plans to give more minutes to young players such as Nico Paz, Franco Mastantuono, Valentin Barco, Matias Soule and Gianluca Prestianni.
background: Scaloni took over in 2018 and won the 2022 World Cup, two Copa America titles and a Finalissima; Argentina lost this summer's World Cup final to Spain.
footage_terms: Scaloni Argentina campeon del mundo 2022 highlights

headline: Como's Nico Paz inherits Messi's No. 10 shirt for Argentina
facts: Paz has 25 goals and 25 assists in 89 games for Como, including 6 goals and 8 assists in 14 games this season.
Real Madrid let Como take his full rights for about 60 million euros this summer, with a clause to re-sign him for 80 million in 2027.
Compared at the same age, Messi created 2.58 chances per 90 against Paz's 1.59, and Paz's shots on target fell from 39.7% to 26%.
background: Paz was born in Tenerife to Pablo Paz, who played for Argentina at the 1998 World Cup, and joined Como from Real Madrid in 2024 for about 6 million euros.
footage_terms: Nico Paz Argentina gol Costa Rica

headline: Messi will play in Argentina on 19 January when Inter Miami face River Plate
facts: Inter Miami will meet River at the Monumental on 19 January in Messi's first club match in his home country.
Miami expect Casemiro, Rodrigo De Paul, Luis Suarez, Nicolas Otamendi and Thiago Almada to travel with him.
Miami open the 2027 MLS season on 19 February against FC Cincinnati.
background: River Plate have 38 domestic titles and four Copa Libertadores trophies; Messi has played 29 matches for Argentina at the Monumental.
footage_terms: Messi River Plate Monumental Inter Miami amistoso
Messi vuelve a Argentina Inter Miami

headline: Messi up for a record third straight MLS MVP award
facts: Messi is an MVP finalist and would be the first player to win it three years in a row.
He also won a second straight Golden Boot after scoring 26 regular-season goals in 2026.
Philadelphia's 17-year-old Cavan Sullivan is the youngest MVP finalist in league history.
background: Messi won MLS MVP in 2024 and 2025; only Preki has won it twice before, in 1997 and 2003.
footage_terms: Messi Golden Boot 2026 Inter Miami goals

headline: Messi's non-league club Cornella: a million followers but two wins in ten
facts: Cornella's social following grew from about 35,000 to over a million, with Adidas and MyInvestor among new sponsors.
On the pitch the fifth-tier side have won only 2 of their first 10 league games and drew 1-1 in front of fewer than 1,000 fans in a stand holding about 700.
Messi also bought second-division Eldense and the deal awaits approval from Spain's CSD.
background: Messi took over Cornella in April 2026; the club went through back-to-back relegations and its 2012 sale of Jordi Alba to Barcelona reportedly earned 1.4 million euros.

headline: Pochettino leaves the US job to take over 18th-placed Manchester United
facts: Pochettino left his US head coach role during the international break to replace Michael Carrick and says he sleeps only three or four hours a day preparing for the trip to Liverpool.
United are 18th with one win in 10 league games, their lowest total at this stage since 1986-87, and have no clean sheet this season.
He has not won any of his last eight meetings with Liverpool across his spells at Tottenham and Chelsea.
background: Pochettino is an Argentine coach who previously managed Tottenham and Chelsea; Opta gives Liverpool a 57.3% chance in the match.
footage_terms: Liverpool vs Manchester United Pochettino preview

headline: Ecuadorian player banned for eight years for throwing a stone at a referee
facts: Midfielder Jhon Michel Perlaza threw a stone from the bench that hit an assistant referee in the face in the 96th minute of a third-tier match on 17 October.
The assistant referee fractured a cheekbone, needed surgery and was off work for 60 days.
The federation banned Perlaza until 19 October 2034, fined his club 2,000 dollars and ordered three home games at a neutral venue.
background: The Ecuadorian federation will also ask FIFA to extend the ban worldwide.
footage_terms: Ecuador jugador suspendido ocho anos arbitro
